detail.longDescription: "A thousand people voluntarily buried their cotton underpants for two months—not to keep the Underpants Gnomes from stealing them, but as part of a citizen science project to map out soil health in 25 countries around the world. The results of this unique experiment were reported in a new paper published in the journal Plants People Planet." https:// arstechnica.com/science/2026/0 8/why-did-1000-swiss-citizens-bury-their-underpants/ # Research # Soil # Environment # CitizenScience
